license: Bundled originals and ported cases retain Apache-2.0; the new harness/driver use the project MIT license.
selection: All 782 iso_ definitions across 93 source files, including disabled definitions and alternate branches. Other upstream test prefixes are outside this inventory.
port: Strip Logtalk object wrappers and lower lgtunit calls only in goal positions. Preserve data braces, lists, sharing and helpers.
Run file and stream fixtures as ordinary ISO Prolog clauses in per-case temporary directories.
Use an explicit standard exception alternative rather than permissive legacy/module variants. Both expectations are recorded per case.
Replay the two declared retract/1 predecessor chains within each fresh worker.
Correct iso_setof_3_17 to accept either implementation-dependent relative variable order; preserve both order patterns.
Correct iso_read_term_3_05 to require syntax_error without an assertion about undefined consumed input; reader behavior is unchanged.
Enable six implementation-defined bitwise examples using documented unbounded two-complement and arithmetic-shift results; retain upstream-disabled provenance and chosen values per case.
limits: ISO-undefined STO cases, including the corresponding active branches, are SKIP and do not prescribe extension behavior.
Runtime conditions are evaluated; disabled bitwise examples explicitly document and test implementation-defined results.
The one deterministic expectation checks exactly one answer; ISO cannot portably inspect residual choice points.
Only explicit =~= expectations use approximation. Other numeric equality checks remain exact.
The corpus is not a complete ISO specification; names, counts and passing results are not conformance certification.
